Quarterly review of the CV. Close this issue when every item is done or skipped on purpose.

- [ ] Run the `cv-propose` skill locally and review the proposals.
- [ ] Download a fresh LinkedIn data export and run `make linkedin`; go through the checklist.
- [ ] Run `make skills` and review the differences against the self-reported answers.
- [ ] Resolve every claim marked `status: verify` in `cv.yaml`.
- [ ] If the content changed, publish the pending draft release.
